description: Quality ratchet baseline — metrics must never regress below these values. Updated after Alpha Discovery Engine (Phase 1-20) added ~2400 new tests and src/alpha-lab module. Coverage thresholds reflect new module inclusion. anyTypes/consoleCalls reflect pre-existing debt in non-alpha-lab code. quality.oversizedFileBaseline (added v1.1.0, S14): frozen snapshot of src/**/*.ts(x) files exceeding maxFileSizeLines, generated by scripts/oversized-file-check.mjs collectFileLineCounts (visual line count: split on newline, trailing newline does not create a phantom line). Pass rule: no NEW violator and no line-count growth vs snapshot; shrinking is allowed. Prune fixed entries with: node scripts/check-quality-baseline.mjs --prune-oversized-snapshot (prune-only — it can never add entries; adding debt requires a deliberate manual edit).

coverage.note: Raised after :any elimination (PR #115) — all green at lines 94.29%, functions 92.17%, branches 86.27%, statements 93.2%

updatePolicy: NEVER decrease thresholds. Only increase when genuine improvement is verified.
